description: This file contains functions and variables related to the platform-specific upgrade process for the OpenWrt firmware, including a check function and an upgrade function that delegates to a default method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by invoking different functions based on the board name.
